entries.130753c02ea4c5df: In May 2026, the company formulated the medium-term management plan “VISION2030,” with the fiscal year ending March 2031 as its final year. Its theme is “Move Forward – The Power to Keep Changing, Toward the Future,” and it will pursue three strategies (business portfolio strategy, financial strategy and sustainability strategy) and strengthen its management foundation. The company states that on the business side it will invest actively in the wireless systems business in the Safety & Security field, which leads the company as a whole; develop the wireless systems business for public safety markets and the entertainment business as areas of expectation and challenge; and restructure the aftermarket business in the Mobility & Telematics Services field.
